title: Seal wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff4f7b'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#ffe14f'/>
  <polygon points='38,32 62,32 60,27 40,27' fill='#5fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#ffe14f'/>
  <!-- seal body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#8fa6c4'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='74' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#6f87a8' transform='rotate(-20 21 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='74' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#6f87a8' transform='rotate(20 79 74)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#a7bcd8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#c3d4ea'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#2b3450'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#2b3450'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a4460'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 Q50 58 46 58 M50 53 Q50 58 54 58' stroke='#3a4460' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='53' r='0.9' fill='#6f87a8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='57' r='0.9' fill='#6f87a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='53' r='0.9' fill='#6f87a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='57' r='0.9' fill='#6f87a8'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='9' fill='#c3d4ea'/>
</svg>
